item.title: U.S. women's hockey captain ties goal record at 2026 Winter Olympics
item.description: Olympian and U.S. ice hockey captain Hilary Knight tied the record for the most career Olympic goals on Saturday, making team history and cementing the U.S.'s 5-0 win over Finland.

item.title: Man sentenced to life for human trafficking case spanning to North Florida
item.description: An Alabama man was sentenced to Life in prison on Friday on human trafficking charges.

item.title: Free admission at Florida State Parks, 50% off kayak rentals for 250th anniversary of U.S.
item.description: To celebrate America’s 250th anniversary, Florida state parks are offering free admission from Feb. 13 to Feb. 16. Meanwhile, a company is offering 50% off kayak rentals as a winter special.

item.title: Savannah Guthrie agrees to pay ransom, pleads for mother's safe return
item.description: A new video from Today show host Savannah Guthrie was posted Saturday, pleading for her mother's safe return and saying the family will agree to pay a ransom, as the search for Nancy Guthrie enters its seventh day.

item.title: Florida man sentenced to over 27 years in prison for sex trafficking 2 women
item.description: A man was sentenced to just over 27 years in prison after pleading guilty to sex trafficking two women in Daytona.

item.title: Ilia Malinin's stunning free skate secures US figure skating team gold at Milan Cortina Olympics
item.description: Ilia Malinin beat Japanese rival Shun Sato in a head-to-head showdown at the Milan Cortina Olympics on Sunday night, helping the U.S. defend its team figure skating gold medal by breaking a deadlock with Japan in the final session of the competition.

item.title: Fire 'intentionally' set at home of Republican candidate for Florida governor
item.description: A fire was intentionally set on the property of a Republican candidate running for Florida governor, according to a statement released by his campaign on Sunday.

item.title: No believed survivors after Venice-based Agape Flights plane crashes in Haiti
item.description: A Sarasota County-based Christian missionary organization lost contact with one of its planes on Thursday afternoon.
